novelty_search.nearest_result: The paired-reader audit rejects one cross-bank affine temporal scalar and requires task-gated readers; no gate has been extracted from the local reader values.
novelty_search.new_question: Can the two exact local contrasts route among q_has, q_is, and abstention across held-out constructions, while preserving the already measured causal effects?

frozen_gate.training: All 32 A1 records label their bank; C records with group_number 0..7 label abstain. A2/P and C groups 8..15 are never used for fit.
frozen_gate.standardization: Training-set coordinate mean and population standard deviation.
frozen_gate.classifier: Nearest standardized class centroid under squared Euclidean distance; lexical tie-break has_had, is_was, abstain.
frozen_gate.fitted_values: Two means, two scales, and three two-dimensional centroids = 10 scalars.
frozen_gate.dispatch: Predicted bank applies that bank's already measured write; abstain uses base. No new head/model evaluation is needed because base/own/partner margins are persisted.
frozen_gate.no_rescue: Do not add features, tune distance, move split, change classifier, or relax bars after a null.

bars.routing: A2 and P accuracy >=0.75 separately for each bank; held-out C abstention accuracy >=0.75.
bars.dispatched_A: A2 dispatched mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75 in each bank.
bars.dispatched_P: P dispatched mean reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75 in each bank.
bars.dispatched_C: Held-out C mean normalized unrelated effect <=0.20 across both banks.
bars.coverage: 48 training records and 80 test records, all disjoint by row within class/split; zero model work.

predictions.pred_a_hash_rows_split_and_margin_identi: All hashes, builder joins, row splits, and persisted base/own/partner margins are exact and finite.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_three_way_gate: The ten-scalar nearest-centroid gate is fit exactly once with no test access or tie ambiguity.
predictions.pred_c_heldout_construction_task_routing: Both A2/P bank cells and held-out C abstention pass routing bars.
predictions.pred_d_dispatched_A_P_causal_preservatio: Both banks pass dispatched A2 and P causal bars.
predictions.pred_e_dispatched_C_selectivity: Held-out C passes the 0.20 selectivity bar.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_zero_forward_p: Exactly 48 train and 80 test records use 10 fitted scalars and zero forward/backward/grid/root/update.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: the two local contrasts implement a bounded automatic task gate for the dual program.
terminal.null: Authority/gate/coverage pass but routing or dispatched causal behavior misses; local contrasts do not suffice for task routing.
terminal.invalid: Authority, split, identity, finiteness, fit, or coverage fails.
